fixture_clock: time.sleep patched and recorded; no wall clock waits
cleanup: pytest tmp_path homes and the module scoped ledger folder; no live resource mutations
mutation_scope: Comments and joins on the fixture ledger only; the in-process server is the single writer of its SQLite file
survived: The write applied before the lost response; the SQLite ledger kept one comment through two replays of the same op id
lost: The first write response and two read connections; reads recovered on the third attempt
